needs.detail: The supported-check formatter joins raw internal codes. Supply human check names through Writer references; a draft string cannot make raw IDs user-facing prose.

All Foundry source literals/default formatters need real Writer CopyRef bindings on the three admin pages; ANS6463569911 classifies inline bindings as P0. Extracting draft records does not activate them.

DocumentFrame requires host title and meta content and supplies no product copy. Inspect and bind the actual caller-owned head records; do not invent a Foundry title or reword developer contract exceptions as user-visible errors.
Actor names, account section labels, entries, command titles/search/empty text, navigation nodes and panel labels are host supplied. No Foundry-owned wording can be inferred from this component.

The empty tree does not distinguish no permission from no configuration/loading. Do not promise access advice or recovery action until the host provides a reason/action; unconditional safe draft is No pages available.

React Aria owns default SearchField clear and toast close/region announcements; no Foundry literal exists here. Test translated host/engine wording in the mechanical/locale audit rather than extracting invented source records.
Inspector heading and identity facts expose the permanent leaf ID. A registered human display name and a deliberately separate technical-details view are needed; changing the leaf ID is forbidden.
The inspector prints the raw package pin object. A copy record cannot convert this structured value into a readable source/version summary.
The inspector prints renderer-root symbols and constituent IDs as its content. It needs human names with technical identifiers kept separately.
Raw check codes and diagnostic messages are user-visible. Each diagnostic needs a user-facing summary and a supported next step; these cannot be safely guessed from codes.
Change history exposes commands, hashes and raw JSON. It needs readable change summaries; do not rewrite command syntax or hashes as copy.
The change command is printed as code and copied verbatim. Keep executable text exact and place user-facing instructions separately; never rewrite command bytes.
Usage links take their visible labels from raw graph IDs. Human names are needed in graph presentation without altering identity or navigation.
Usage rows expose owner-held inventory labels and reason codes. LIST only: introduce a readable summary/presentation contract in the owning lane, never edit the inventory in this unit.
Missing-link details expose diagnostic codes and raw subjects. The badge rewrite alone does not supply an understandable cause and recovery action.
Options are rendered as raw member IDs. They require display labels while preserving the underlying member values.
Canvas item labels fall back to permanent leaf IDs. Supply a human display-name projection; retain the ID for identity and navigation only.
Canvas edge-item accessible labels are always raw leaf IDs even when a visible item name is available. The accessibility label must use the same display name.
The checks table prints internal code lists and raw messages. Copy records alone cannot map the variable code set to faithful user summaries.
The checks rail may render a raw evaluation error. The owner must provide a user-facing error summary and recovery action, not a guessed successful retry button.
